text:
marta_ops: flagging a provisioning hit  batch H200-APAC-042 arrived with saltwater residue on pallets. Seeing intermittent DOA and sticky connectors. Quarantine at AMS depot.

han_procure: which PO and qty? can we triage without impacting EU reservations?

marta_ops: PO 59400, qty 180. Initial triage: 11 units DOA, ~22 units with connector corrosion. Holding remaining for deeper checks.

tori_logistics: broker flagged saline contamination on manifest. We need SDR + container inspection. Crossdock hold initiated: AMS-CD12.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor acknowledges possible port-side mishandling. They propose either depot repair + tech kit or immediate air replacements for critical customers while insurance processes claim.

ryan_sales: customer impact: apac tenants rely on those allocations next week. If we pull from global buffer, EMEA suffers. Need costed mitigation.

claims-bot: Claim IC-2026-912 opened. Required docs: photos, container survey, humidity and salinity sensor logs, invoice, packing list. Adjuster: Petra.

marta_ops: ops plan draft: 1) isolate batch at AMS-CD12, 2) run quick power+bench on 40 samples, 3) tag `salt-contact` on affected serials, 4) request vendor preflight bench logs for any repaired unit.

# depot quick test (depot-tech):
```
power-on --unit $SERIAL --log /ams/logs/$SERIAL.boot
inference-bench --model tinybert --seq 16 --iters 60 --timeout 120s > /ams/logs/$SERIAL.bench
grep -E "ERR|corros|short|thermal_trip" /ams/logs/$SERIAL.* | sed -n '1,60p'
```

depot-tech: starting bench on first 20 units now. Will tag and photo ones with residue.

han_procure: commercial negotiation strategy: demand vendor covers return freight + air for up to 12 critical replacements, and 4% credit on PO if we accept depot refurb for remainder. Also request vendor-supplied depot tech kits free of charge.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor reply: will provide depot kits and cover depot labor for 48h. Air replacements for 8 units within 5 days if we sign a limited holdback (2%); otherwise depot route with 2.5% credit. They refuse blanket 4% credit.

ryan_sales: we need at least 10 air units to keep top-tier customers unimpacted. Can procurement push for 3.5% + 10 air units?

han_procure: pushing for that. Also require per-serial preflight: bench_id, therm_profile, power_cycle logs. No shipback without that.

marta_ops: technical note: even slight corrosion on connectors increases tail-latency variance. Depot rework must include connector replacement and a KV cache retention test. Add `kv_cache_check` to bench run.

depot-tech: added KV retention test to script. Will append results to the bench log.

claims-bot: adjuster Petra requested container ingress time-window and port handling invoices. Broker: ship legs show heavy seas 2026-03-11. Salinity alarm tripped.

tori_logistics: customs/broker note: reclassification for repair parts required to avoid duties on replacements. Filed HS amendment AM-59400. Expected 18-24h.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor new offer: 3% credit + depot kits + cover return freight if we accept depot rework for up to 160 units, plus 10 air replacements within 5 days for critical accounts. They will provide promised preflight bench logs for repaired units.

han_procure: counter: 3.5% credit + vendor covers duties if insurer denies + 12 air units. Also insist on depot preflight logs within 48h of receiving depot-reworked units.

ryan_sales: I'm ok to present a compromise to customers if we secure 12 air units and daily updates. I'll prep the customer message.

marta_ops: ops checklist if accepted: 1) finish 40 bench runs, 2) label affected serials with `rma-salt` tag, 3) create RMA draft RMA-2026-6020 with fields: unit_count=33, preflight_required=true, bench_fields=[bench_id,therm_profile,kv_cache_check], 4) prepare crossdock transfer for buffers.

depot-tech: first 20 runs done: 6 DOA, 9 with connector surface corrosion but pass bench after connector clean; tagging and photos uploaded.

claims-bot: Petra requested humidity + salinity sensor logs; broker uploaded salinity spike at 0.8 ppt on 2026-03-11 02:40 UTC. Photo set PKG-59400-IMG attached.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor agrees in principle to 12 air units and 3.25% credit if we sign RMA and allow depot rework for remainder. They will provide preflight logs for repaired units and cover return freight.

han_procure: accept 12 air units + 3.25% credit contingent on signed commercial amendment that includes duty rebate clause if insurer denies. Drafting amendment now.

marta_ops: please include SLA: depot preflight bench logs must include bench_id and KV retention graph, and vendor must commit to replacements for any unit failing preflight within 3 days. Add that clause.

nexa_supply_ops: vendor accepted the preflight SLA clause in call. Will send signed amendment within 4h.

ryan_sales: I'll queue the customer comms once amendment received. Tone: calm, mitigation-focused, ETA for critical units included.

depot-tech: continuing runs on next 20. Posting logs as they finish.

marta_ops: thanks everyone. If vendor misses signed amendment by EOD we'll escalate to legal and pause any sign-off on salvage waivers.

han_procure: noted. I'll post the commercial amendment when ready and tag legal for review.

ryan_sales: thanks  prepping a short message: "We discovered transit contamination on a small subset of recent H200s. Affected units quarantined; replacements prioritized for highest-impact customers; we'll provide daily updates."
